title: Separate combined metadata reads under large-index latency
failure_signature: A combined PowerShell read of two lifecycle metadata artifacts exceeded the 30-second wrapper limit even though each artifact remained readable.
trigger_preconditions: the repository carries a large inherited index
multiple lifecycle artifacts are read in one diagnostic wrapper
the wrapper has a short fixed timeout
candidate_workaround: Read one literal lifecycle artifact per command, or raise the bounded read timeout only after confirming the target path and metadata size; do not over-combine diagnostics.
recurrence_guard: Lifecycle diagnostics must prefer one-file literal reads and reserve combined wrappers for operations already measured within their timeout budget.
rollback: If a decomposed read still fails, preserve the failure and stop before interpreting or rewriting the artifact.
scope_boundary: Diagnostic decomposition improves observability only; it does not validate the artifact contents or remove the original timeout.
